name: sinjoh-sdk
description: TypeScript SDK workspace for the immutable Sinjoh protocols on Robinhood Chain.

scripts.generate: npm run generate:abis && npm run generate:deployments
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sinjoh/abis -w @sinjoh/deployments -w @sinjoh/merkle -w @sinjoh/sdk && npm run build -w @sinjoh/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sinjoh/abis -w @sinjoh/deployments -w @sinjoh/merkle -w @sinjoh/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces
